name: Latrina (Latrines)
player_description: The fort latrine runs along the northeast wall. A long stone bench with holes over a channel of running water. No privacy, no partition. You share this with whoever else is on the same watch schedule. Romans consider communal latrine use unremarkable. The sponge-on-a-stick for cleaning is shared. So is everything overheard here.
gm_notes: Best free intelligence location in the fort. Soldiers talk candidly here precisely because they are not in a professional context. DC 10 Perception (passive, anyone who visits): overhear one ambient rumor about fort morale or recent events. DC 12 Perception: a specific conversation between two off-duty soldiers about something that concerns them. Sessions 1-2 ambient rumor table: (1) Vault deaths were not an accident — Sextus's cousin was in the original excavation team. (2) Tribune's Praetorians have been seen near the south granary after dark. (3) Paterculus filed a fourth adverse omen report and Corvinus told him to stop filing. (4) Someone tried to bribe the gate guard last night; guard did not report it upward.
